SwitchPreference.app:title: Automatically block confirmed threats
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Requires a high-confidence malicious match from KotSafe Cloud. Unconfirmed threats, apps and file hashes are sent for review.

SwitchPreference.app:title: Restrict traffic when screen is off
SwitchPreference.app:summary: May delay messages and background app activity. KotSafe P2P transport is excluded; other apps using P2P still follow their firewall rules.

MultiSelectListPreference.app:title: Apps allowed while screen is off
MultiSelectListPreference.app:dialogTitle: Allow these apps while screen is off
MultiSelectListPreference.app:summary: Choose apps that need background messages or calls. KotSafe P2P transport is already excluded.

Preference.app:title: Fewer repeated alerts
Preference.app:summary: Repeated incidents are grouped for five minutes. Higher-risk signals and changes to automatic blocking are reviewed again.
